description: This Java class, ClientSocketHandler, manages client-side socket connections for a Wi-Fi Direct service discovery application. It creates and manages a socket connection to a group owner device, initiates a ChatManager for communication, and runs the chat handling in a separate thread.

classes.name: ClientSocketHandler
classes.description: A thread handling client-side socket connection setup to a Wi-Fi Direct device, establishing communication and starting a chat manager

methods.name: ClientSocketHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler and target address for the socket connection

methods.name: run
methods.description: Establishes socket connection, initializes ChatManager, and starts chat handling thread

methods.name: getChat
methods.description: Returns the ChatManager instance handling communication
